lag_and_group_delay_diagnosis.diagnosis_conclusion: W06's pipeline has exact 0.000 s group delay and window centres `t` match `scipy.signal.stft` (verified on synthetic FM: r=0.9999 at lag=0s, RMSE=0.39 mHz). On ENF-WHU H1/003.wav vs H1_ref/003_ref.wav, even a raw unfiltered scipy.signal.stft with zero W06 code exhibits the exact same +4 s lag (r=0.976 at lag 0 vs r=0.999 at lag +4 s), proving that ENF-WHU's H1 and H1_ref files have small manual start-time trimming offsets of a few seconds (~0 to 4 s).
